names.ru: Южная Георгия и Южные Сандвичевы острова
names.uk: Південна Джорджія та Південні Сандвічеві острови

prices.note: FAOSTAT PP: producer price per tonne, annual, 2015-2024; USD where reported, else local currency at the World Bank annual rate (levels a country stopped publishing are chained from its last level by the FAOSTAT producer price index); to euro at each year’s euro-area rate

production.note: FAOSTAT QCL: production (t), yield (kg/ha) and area harvested, mean 2019-2023; yields kept where a country harvests ≥ 1 000 ha of the crop

trade.note: FAOSTAT TCL: import and export quantity, tonnes, mean 2019-2023

fx.note: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF, euro area: official exchange rate, LCU per US$, period average

plr.note: Price level ratio = World Bank ICP PA.NUS.PPP (PPP conversion factor, GDP) ÷ PA.NUS.FCRF (market rate), latest 2019-2024, ÷ EU median

tariff.note: World Bank TM.TAX.TCOM.SM.AR.ZS: tariff rate, applied, simple mean, primary products (%), latest 2015-2024, capped at 30 % (the mean includes tobacco and alcohol)

shapes.note: Natural Earth 1:50m admin-0 countries and capitals

routes.note: Eurostat maritime network (marnet, via searoute-js): shortest sea path between the ports nearest each capital

shelf.note: USDA Agriculture Handbook 66 (2016): storage life under standard conditions
